papers.title: Lakehouse table formats and query planning in large data lakes
papers.abstract: This synthetic experimental study compares table metadata planning and scan pruning in scalable lakehouse analytics, with reproducibility concerns.
papers.full_text: [PAGE 1] The synthetic lakehouse benchmark uses 8 worker nodes and 40 simulated workloads. Partition pruning reduced scanned files by 29 percent in the toy experiment; this is invented demo evidence. Study limitations: synthetic queries and unreported variance. [PAGE 2] A table-format comparison explored metadata and optimization tradeoffs. No real-world performance claims may be inferred from this fixture.

papers.title: Distributed lakehouse query execution using columnar storage
papers.abstract: A simulated evaluation of distributed lakehouse query execution, data organization, and scaling behavior for big data workloads.
papers.full_text: [PAGE 1] Synthetic experiment: three table layouts on simulated query workloads. Reported median run time 12, 15, and 19 arbitrary units. These numbers are fictional and useful only for pipeline testing. Limitation: no data provenance and no statistical confidence intervals.

papers.title: Adaptive Spark and Iceberg optimization for scalable lakehouse systems
papers.abstract: This illustrative methods paper evaluates adaptive Iceberg maintenance and Spark query planning in data lakehouse systems.
papers.full_text: [PAGE 1] Synthetic methodology: adaptive compaction selected candidate partitions using a cost heuristic. Results were compared with static compaction in illustrative workloads. Evidence quality is limited because no raw evaluation log accompanies this invented text.

papers.title: Sentiment classification of short social-media posts
papers.abstract: An unrelated synthetic work on sentiment classification with transformer models and text datasets; no lakehouse storage or scalable analytics architecture is evaluated.
papers.full_text: [PAGE 1] Toy sentiment classifier trained on social posts, unrelated to lakehouse architecture.

papers.title: Protein crystallography and laboratory measurements
papers.abstract: Synthetic biology research on physical measurements and protein crystallography, not distributed data analytics or lakehouse architectures.
papers.full_text: [PAGE 1] A simulated laboratory protocol for biology, unrelated to the review topic.

papers.title: Cloud lakehouse governance for large analytical platforms
papers.abstract: A fictional study of scalable lakehouse governance, metadata access and data retention. Only an abstract is supplied for testing missing full-text handling.
